arguments.command:
cd /app
# Boot the VM with serial redirected to a file, run for ~60s of boot, then we'll inspect.
# Use timeout to cap it. -nographic sends serial to stdio.
# We give it stdin from /dev/null so it doesn't block on a tty.
timeout 90 qemu-system-x86_64 \
  -m 512 \
  -cdrom /app/alpine.iso \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 \
  -device e1000,netdev=n0 \
  -nographic \
  < /dev/null > /tmp/boot_probe.log 2>&1 &
BOOT_PID=$!
echo "qemu pid: $BOOT_PID"
# Wait up to 90s, checking periodically for the boot progress
for i in $(seq 1 18); do
  sleep 5
  if ! kill -0 $BOOT_PID 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "qemu exited early at iteration $i"
    break
  fi
done
kill $BOOT_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $BOOT_PID 2>/dev/null
echo "=== boot probe log (first 60 lines) ==="
head -60 /tmp/boot_probe.log
echo "..."
echo "=== last 40 lines ==="
tail -40 /tmp/boot_probe.log
